about: The dementia diagnosis at L001 precedes the first Oxytrol patch supply and the finding must cite both the diagnosis and a patch supply.
Possible finding: the record holds no line about dementia or delirium. Tolterodine (Detrusitol, a bladder medicine with strong anticholinergic effects) is supplied every month for 7 months.
Delirium resolved and the assessment ruled out dementia before the first solifenacin supply.
